note: Gas along one PRIYA sightline in real space. x: comoving Mpc/h, pixel centres (j + 1/2) L / nbins. Delta: gas density / mean baryon density at the pixel centre (SPH sum, MP-Gadget's cubic kernel). T: K, HI-weighted. v: km/s, peculiar, HI-weighted, positive away from the observer. colden: HI cm^-2 per pixel. A pixel at x absorbs at u = hubble_per_mpch * x + v; u = 0 at x = 0. reference.tau[k]: fake_spectra's raw tau, mean over u in [k du, (k + 1) du).

provenance.checks: SPH kernel and velocity conventions checked against MP-Gadget 5.0.1-2-gf8abc3f6 (commit f8abc3f6657e) and fake_spectra 2.2.3 source
provenance.relation_to_data_v1: Sister run of the PRIYA run of f5.bin and flux_cube_240.bin, with different parameters. Both runs belong to PRIYA's low-resolution suite (1536^3, 120 Mpc/h). Every staged low-res run records the initial-condition seed 422317; this run's own IC file is not staged, so its seed is inferred, not read. On the hero line its troughs match that run's to within 0.2 Mpc/h in the talk's close-up window, and 100 random skewers give r = 0.00 +- 0.08.
